title: Sensory cortex is hierarchical with asymmetric reciprocal connections

statements.text: The theory predicts that sensory cortex is arranged hierarchically, that connections are reciprocal, and that forward connections are driving while backward connections are both driving and modulatory.

sources.quote: the theoretical treatment predicts that sensory cortex should be arranged hierarchically, that connections should be reciprocal and that forward and backward connections should show a functional asymmetry
